<!-- pr-reviewer: 890bc569774a5fc1965e6f2d4d58d0c9570a08d2 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The single-region entry tests pass. The change keeps the stock height out of the saved project format. No UI files or golden files change.

Local results with upstream/main `af83da0f405cfd244f0c9bf8192ab7309e9db824` trial-merged:

- Build: the five changed app test binaries compile. The motion tests compile.
- App: 33 tests pass across `carried_stock_entry`, `carried_verify`, `ladder_entry_height`, `top_stock`, and `vertical_rapid_stock`.
- Motion: 518 tests pass; 11 tests are ignored. This includes the library and 12 entry, contour, linking, and machining suites.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passes.
- Safety checks: Pocket and Contour each give RED with runtime `material_top=None`, then GREEN with `Some(10)`. RED means that the entry clearance assertion fails. These are runtime parameter mutations. They are not source mutations. No source files changed.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/app/src/operation/top_stock.rs:83`: Check the entry into each separate region before returning false. The first feed below `m` currently stops the scan. A clear first region can thus hide a later rapid into uncut stock. A focused check uses the unchanged helper and the real Pocket and Contour generators, with no prior cut. Two 40 x 30 regions occupy x=0..40 and x=60..100. Stepped stock covers both regions, with tops Z5 and Z10. Top is Z6, Bottom is Z0, Clearance is Z20, Retract is Z15, and the tool diameter is 6 mm. `carried` returns Z10, but `dives_into` returns false. Pocket rapid 7 and Contour rapid 5 descend from `(63,3,15)` to `(63,3,8)`, inside the second stock region. The first region feeds to Z6 in air and causes the early return. Generation therefore does not carry the stock height for the second entry. Add a test for this case. Keep credit for material that earlier cuts removed.

No GitHub runner was used. The focused checks ran from temporary review files outside the PR tree. The review made no source edits.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the first air feed no longer stops the stock-entry check. Every descending rapid is checked, including entries into later regions. Local stock height and prior-cut credit are preserved.

Pins: `pocket_checks_later_region_after_air_feed_and_keeps_prior_credit` and `contour_checks_later_region_after_air_feed_and_keeps_prior_credit`. Both use the real generators with the review's stepped-stock fixture. Both fail with the original early return restored and pass with the fix. They also check partial and full prior-cut credit.

Validation: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed. Clippy passed for `camcraft-app` and `camcraft-motion`, all targets, with warnings denied.

New head: `299a15578d06191a2c10c1781f2349691e017342`.

Please re-review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 299a15578d06191a2c10c1781f2349691e017342 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The earlier finding is resolved. The check now reads all descending rapids. An air feed in the first region cannot hide stock in a later region. The two new tests also retain partial and full prior-cut credit.

Local results with upstream/main `af83da0f405cfd244f0c9bf8192ab7309e9db824` trial-merged:

- Build: the app library, five changed app test binaries, and selected motion test binaries compile.
- App unit tests: 7 pass in `operation::top_stock`, including both new multi-region tests.
- App integration tests: 33 pass across `carried_stock_entry`, `carried_verify`, `ladder_entry_height`, `top_stock`, and `vertical_rapid_stock`.
- Motion: 516 pass; 11 are ignored. The run covers the library and 12 related suites. These are `adaptive_hsm`, `bore_ramp_angle`, `center_cut_law`, `circular_ramp_angle`, `contour_auto_side`, `contour_inside_ramp`, `entry_approach`, `entry_arc`, `entry_ramp_angle`, `level_links`, `machining2d`, and `predrilled_entry`.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passes.

Safety mutation checks:

1. Restore the old early return in an external copy of `top_stock.rs`. Both new Pocket and Contour tests fail with `an earlier air feed must not acquit the later region` (RED). Use the fixed helper: both pass (GREEN).
2. Set runtime `material_top=None` for Pocket and Contour. Each later entry stops at Z8 and fails the Z12 clearance check (RED). Set `Some(10)`: each stops at Z12 and passes (GREEN).

The source mutation used temporary copies outside the PR tree. The generators came from the local build. The review changed no repository source files.

No requested changes remain. No UI files or golden files change. The saved project format does not change. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The latest review on `299a15578d06191a2c10c1781f2349691e017342` says no requested changes remain.

Resolved the `conflicts` refresh by merging upstream/main `ef1f53451be1ce8a4b45f64e519a328986683ef0`. The only conflict was the export list in `operation/mod.rs`. Both the clearance-stock and carried-stock exports are kept. Main's clearance checks remain intact.

Both existing pins pass: `pocket_checks_later_region_after_air_feed_and_keeps_prior_credit` and `contour_checks_later_region_after_air_feed_and_keeps_prior_credit`. All 8 `clearance_in_stock` tests pass, including unsafe-clearance posting refusals and prior-cut credit.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed: 2,878 tests passed, 67 ignored, no failures. Clippy passed for camcraft-app and camcraft-motion, all targets, with warnings denied.

The PR was converted to draft before the normal push. Labels were left unchanged.

New head: `7a8342125470fa2788f646a281afb8bfa259fd28`.

Please re-review the merge resolution.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 7a8342125470fa2788f646a281afb8bfa259fd28 -->
The code checks pass. The PR cannot merge because it conflicts with current main.

The export resolution in `operation/mod.rs` keeps both stock checks. The earlier finding remains resolved. Both tests for later regions pass. They also retain credit for earlier cuts.

Local build and test results:

- The trial merge with upstream/main `4b7a6b1e8` failed in `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`. I aborted that merge. All results below apply to the PR head, without current main merged.
- App: the library and six selected integration test binaries compile. Seven stock-top unit tests and 41 integration tests pass.
- The app suites are `carried_stock_entry`, `carried_verify`, `ladder_entry_height`, `top_stock`, `vertical_rapid_stock`, and `clearance_in_stock`. All eight clearance tests pass.
- Motion: the library and 12 selected integration suites compile. 525 tests pass; 11 are ignored.
- The motion suites are `adaptive_hsm`, `bore_ramp_angle`, `center_cut_law`, `circular_ramp_angle`, `contour_auto_side`, `contour_inside_ramp`, `entry_approach`, `entry_arc`, `entry_ramp_angle`, `level_links`, `machining2d`, and `predrilled_entry`.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes.

Safety checks use the real Pocket and Contour generators with two separate regions. Top is Z6. The taller stock is Z10.

1. Pocket: set runtime `material_top=None`. The later entry ends at Z8. The Z12 clearance assertion fails (RED). Set `Some(10)`: the entry ends at Z12 and the assertion passes (GREEN).
2. Contour: repeat the same runtime mutation. The entry ends at Z8 and fails (RED), then ends at Z12 and passes (GREEN).

These are runtime parameter mutations. They are not source mutations. The harness is in `/tmp`, outside the repository. No repository source files changed. No UI files or golden files change in this PR. No GitHub runner was used.

Before merge:

1. `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:608`: resolve the conflict with current main. This PR adds carried-stock generation. Main adds `rest_pocket` selection at the same location. Keep both behaviours and run the relevant tests again. The trial merge also conflicts at the generation call near line 630. I did not resolve this code conflict.

The label is `conflicts`. Remove `merge-ready` until the branch merges with current main. Keep the PR as a draft.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: no findings fixed. Stopped at the same-logic conflict required by the author-side instructions.

The latest review requests the generate.rs conflict resolution. Merging upstream/main 4b7a6b1e87d3db22222ea3132f95a45f20a45f8a reproduces two conflict hunks in crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs, in run_job_arms (Pocket arm), near lines 608 and 630.

The PR makes PocketParams mutable, calls pocket_entered, and calls it again with material_top when carry_need finds uncut stock. Main keeps PocketParams immutable and selects rest_pocket for Some(rest), or pocket_entered for None. Both sides change the same generation call. Resolving it requires deciding how carried-stock regeneration applies to rest-pocket generation. The instructions require stopping on this kind of conflict.

I aborted the merge. Head remains 7a8342125470fa2788f646a281afb8bfa259fd28. No source edits, commits, pushes, pins, or mutation checks were made. The gate and clippy were not run because the merge was aborted. The PR remains a draft. Labels are unchanged.

Please re-review the reported conflict and provide an authorized resolution before another fix attempt.

M5 merged `upstream/main` into this branch by hand. Head is now `2b790f6ab`. The class is DELTA, so this needs a delta review of the remerge-diff.

The Codex refresh stopped at a same-logic conflict. The two sides are compatible:
- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` (Pocket arm): main chooses `rest_pocket` (with rest) or `pocket_entered` (without rest). This PR re-generates the pocket with the entries lifted when `carry_need!` finds carried stock above the entry. The merge keeps both: the same chosen generator runs again with `material_top` set. Only the entry plane moves. The cut does not change.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket.rs`: #2154 moved the pass emission to `pocket_emit.rs`. The merge takes main's `pocket.rs` and applies this PR's `entry_top` in `pocket_emit.rs`.

Gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed in all suites except one test, `first_4axis_part::the_committed_project_posts_the_committed_program`. That test also fails on main `2ee745631` (batch tier), so this merge does not cause it.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 2b790f6ab8f6b3be420745f25ff4b3c015262a00 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The manual merge resolves the earlier conflict. The Pocket arm keeps the choice between `rest_pocket` and `pocket_entered`. It uses the same generator for the carried-stock retry. The moved pass emitter keeps the `entry_top` call. The clearance checks remain intact.

The earlier stock-entry finding remains resolved. Both tests for later regions pass. They retain partial and full credit for earlier cuts.

Local results against upstream/main `e3ca44fa705d71438a8fd8a8efccbafcc2b6517f`:

- The trial merge is clean. The PR already contains this main commit.
- The app library and eight selected integration test binaries compile.
- App stock-top unit tests: 7 pass.
- App integration tests: 120 pass. The suites are `carried_stock_entry`, `carried_verify`, `clearance_in_stock`, `ladder_entry_height`, `project_roundtrip`, `rest_pocket`, `top_stock`, and `vertical_rapid_stock`.
- The motion library and 14 selected integration test binaries compile.
- Motion tests: 553 pass; 11 are ignored. This includes the library, `adaptive_hsm`, `bore_ramp_angle`, `center_cut_law`, `circular_ramp_angle`, `contour_auto_side`, `contour_inside_ramp`, `entry_approach`, `entry_arc`, `entry_ramp_angle`, `level_links`, `machining2d`, `predrilled_entry`, `rest2d`, and `rest_adaptive`.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes.

Safety mutation checks use the real generators with two separate regions. Top is Z6. The taller stock is Z10.

1. Pocket: set runtime `material_top=None`. The later entry ends at Z8 and fails the Z12 clearance assertion (RED). Set `Some(10)`: the entry ends at Z12 and passes (GREEN).
2. Contour: repeat the runtime mutation. The entry ends at Z8 and fails (RED), then ends at Z12 and passes (GREEN).

These are runtime parameter mutations, not source mutations. The harness and its executable are in `/tmp`. No repository source files changed.

No requested changes remain. No UI files or golden files change. The saved project format does not change. The review ran selected suites, not the full quick gate. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
